movelist.name: Growl
movelist.effect: Growl lowers all Legal Targets Attack 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Synthesis
movelist.effect: The user regains Hit Points equal to half of its full Hit Point value. If it is Sunny, the user gains 2/3 of its full Hit Point value instead. If it is Rainy, Sand Storming or Hailing the user gains 1/4 of their full Hit Point value instead.

movelist.name: Razor Leaf
movelist.effect: Razor Leaf is a Critical Hit on 18+.

movelist.name: Reflect
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Reflect may activate it when receiving Physical Damage to resist the Damage one step. Reflect may be activated 2 times, and then disappears.

abilities.name: Healer
abilities.effect: The target is cured of all Status conditions.

abilities.name: Leaf Guard
abilities.effect: The user is cured of one Status Affliction. Leaf Guard’s Frequency is ignored if used during Sunny Weather.
